description.value: Jimoco Café & Pasta is a warm, sit-down restaurant in Port Coquitlam offering Italian classics with a Korean twist — think bolognese lasagna alongside a braised soy-and-star-anise pork belly rice bowl. The restaurant pitches itself as suitable for everything from quick lunches to romantic dinners, with catering services also available. Cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities area would find a full-menu sit-down meal or a pickup order waiting for them.
